<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferRequest" name="Request for shipping offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingOffers" name="Shipping offers"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShipping</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WriteLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehousemen" name="Warehousemen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Unspecified" name="Responsibility not specified">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ShippingRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPost</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AmountMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InsuranceJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ShippingRequired" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Clarify who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Packaging and shipping arrangements can proceed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package the goods"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Choose shipping by amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_OfferRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from the logistic companies" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Select one logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountMerge" name="Shipping method selected"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" name="Arrange package label and necessary insurance"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Write a package label"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceJoin" name="Label and necessary insurance arranged"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Packaging and shipping arrangements ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare the packaged goods for pickup by the logistic company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ShippingRequired" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">largeAmount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">smallAmount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountMerge" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticCompanies" name="Three logistic companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfferRequest" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies" messageRef="Message_OfferRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingOffers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffers"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: Use an inclusive split when one or more conditions can be true; use an inclusive join to synchronize only activated reachable branches.
rules.situation: the description states that multiple activities can proceed independently, with at least one activity conditional and another required

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process: Label each BPMN element according to the meaning of its corresponding described trigger, activity, or outcome; do not substitute a different stage or its purpose or result.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes a decision, activity, or outcome from other actions or stages in the process

rules.instruction: Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.
rules.situation: the description assigns work in the same workflow to multiple stated roles or departments.

rules.instruction: Use an exclusive split when exactly one data-based alternative runs. Add supported conditions and at most one default fallback.
rules.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes receiving proposals or offers from choosing among them: Model the choice as a separate activity rather than treating receipt of a proposal or offer as the choice.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes receiving proposals or offers from choosing among them

rules.instruction: When the description states that an item is prepared for collection or transfer once the required prerequisites are ready: Model the preparation as an activity, rather than treating readiness only as a state or omitting the step; when it completes the described process outcome, represent that completion with an end event.
rules.situation: the description states that an item is prepared for collection or transfer once the required prerequisites are ready

rules.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition: model an exclusive gateway to route the process into the applicable alternative, with outgoing flows reflecting the stated conditions
rules.situation: the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives selected according to a stated condition

rules.instruction: When the description identifies multiple external organizations as interchangeable candidates for the same interaction and says that one is selected: Model the candidates collectively as one external participant, rather than creating a separate pool and message flow for each candidate.
rules.situation: the description identifies multiple external organizations as interchangeable candidates for the same interaction and says that one is selected
